actions.description: Arrive without a Body and discover how to create one.
Choose a name, Memory Lantern, and Tutorial; review the selection.
Create the Body. It remains resting until you explicitly wake it.
Use the Tutorial's Wake action to start the selected plots.
Use the current working plot and type hello. Observe the actual result.
Return to the Tutorial and read guidance based on this Body's actual history.
Read all the current Tutorial content, including content beyond the first viewport.
Rest the Body and retain its identity and installed plots.
Finish the Body and retain its closed biography for inspection.
